Messages.Body:
The text on the smiling jack the anarch card says 'you put 1 blood on etc ' is

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:


Peace Michael,

TTBOMK, the payment is _mandatory_. It does cost everyone else at the table
more than you, though, as they are paying the addative total (1+2+3+4+...) and
you are only paying one per turn.

Nil carborundum illigitimi,
